summary: Test suite is solid and comprehensive for core functionality. PrLabelAssigner.Tests.ps1 thoroughly exercises glob patterns (literals, *, **, **/, metacharacter escaping), label aggregation, priority ordering, and exclusive rule semantics. Error cases (missing files, malformed JSON) are well-tested. Workflow.Tests.ps1 validates trigger declarations, job structure, permissions, and actionlint compliance. Run-ActTests.ps1 provides end-to-end validation through `act` with three representative scenarios. **Gaps:** The -AsJson flag is implemented but never unit-tested; GITHUB_OUTPUT behavior is not tested; empty changed-files array and multiple exclusive rules matching the same file lack explicit test coverage; special characters in paths and case sensitivity are untested. Run-ActTests.ps1 is not a Pester test file, which conflicts with the requirement that "all tests must be runnable with `Invoke-Pester`" (it runs as a standalone harness). Fixtures directory is referenced but structure/contents not shown. Would catch regressions in core labeling logic and workflow structure, but misses feature completeness validation.
